statements.statement: The patient has a history of nonrheumatic mitral valve insufficiency
The patient reports recurrent episodes of palpitations accompanied by intermittent dizziness and giddiness
Mobile cardiac telemetry monitoring (CPT 93229) is ordered
The service is ordered to correlate symptomatic events with underlying arrhythmias and assess the hemodynamic impact of the valvular disease
The associated diagnoses are I34.0, R00.2, and R42
